title: Source test: postgres-cdc as a job source is a capability failure
summary: Tests postgres-cdc in the job role. It is a change-stream source with no list(), so a job built from it cannot run; the test must fail at stage capability without contacting the database.

steps.title: POST /api/v1/sources/test
steps.explain: The real source test the console calls before saving a source.

steps.title: ok is false
steps.explain: A job cannot be built from a stream-only source.

steps.title: stage is capability
steps.explain: The refusal must come from the capability stage, before any probe.

steps.title: level is partial
steps.explain: Nothing was contacted, so the result must not claim tested.

steps.title: Message explains list() is missing
steps.explain: The user must be told why it cannot run as a job.
